# Auto Sound Cape Coral

> Auto Sound is a top-rated automotive and marine electronics shop in Cape Coral, Florida, in business since 2004. We install car audio, window tinting, marine audio, key fobs, Apple CarPlay, dash cams, backup cameras, and certified ignition interlock devices. 633 Google reviews at 4.5 stars — more than any auto electronics shop in Lee County.

## Business facts

- Name: Auto Sound Cape Coral
- Address: 1118 Cape Coral Parkway East, Cape Coral, FL 33904
- Phone / Text: (239) 542-8830
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Sunday closed. Walk-ins welcome.
- Founded: 2004 (20+ years serving Southwest Florida)
- Reviews: 4.5 stars, 633 Google reviews
- Service area: Cape Coral, Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres, North Fort Myers, Pine Island, Estero, Punta Gorda, Bonita Springs
- Authorized dealer: Rockford Fosgate, JL Audio, Kenwood, Alpine, Wet Sounds, Fusion

## Services

- [Window Tinting Cape Coral](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/window-tinting.html): ceramic and carbon film, from $149, lifetime warranty, Florida-legal shades.
- [Car Audio / Car Stereo Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/car-audio.html): head units, speakers, subwoofers, amplifiers, full custom builds. Rockford Fosgate authorized dealer.
- [Marine Audio Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/marine-audio.html): waterproof speakers, marine amps and subs for boats — built for salt, sun, and spray.
- [Apple CarPlay & Android Auto Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/apple-carplay.html): add wired or wireless CarPlay to most vehicles, keep steering-wheel controls.
- [Key Fob Replacement & Programming](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/key-fob.html): battery, repair, replacement, and programming — from $15, much cheaper than the dealer.
- [Ignition Interlock (IID) Installation](https://autosoundcapecoral.com/iid-installation.html): certified installer for Intoxalock, Smart Start, and LifeSafer, with local calibrations.
- Also: dash cams, backup cameras, LED lighting.
